name: physio-website
description: Physiotherapy clinic website + admin portal on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and KV

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply physio-db --local -c site/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler-local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply physio-db --remote -c site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute physio-db --local -c site/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler-local --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute physio-db --remote -c site/wrangler.jsonc --file db/seed.sql
scripts.admin:create:local: node scripts/create-admin.mjs && wrangler d1 execute physio-db --local -c site/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler-local --file db/admin-user.local.sql
scripts.admin:create:remote: node scripts/create-admin.mjs admin live && wrangler d1 execute physio-db --remote -c site/wrangler.jsonc --file db/admin-user.local.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:admin
